title: Manage a customer renewal or expansion
summary: Before a customer contract reaches its renewal or expansion decision point. An authorized renewal, changed agreement or planned non-renewal reconciled with service and billing.
outcomes: An authorized renewal, changed agreement or planned non-renewal reconciled with service and billing.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before a customer contract reaches its renewal or expansion decision point.

parts.title: Establish the contract timeline and evidence
parts.guidance: Gather the signed terms, renewal and notice provisions, current usage, support issues and value delivered. Confirm the customer contacts and flag dates that need contract-owner review.

references.title: GitLab retain and expand operating procedures

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review outcomes and future needs with the customer
parts.guidance: Discuss actual results, unresolved concerns and the customer's next priorities. Distinguish an agreed need from a sales assumption and identify delivery or security changes requiring review.

references.title: GitLab retain and expand operating procedures

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Review outcomes and future needs with the customer

parts.title: Prepare renewal and expansion alternatives
parts.guidance: Model the proposed scope, price, implementation and support implications against approved commercial policy. Show the effects of a smaller renewal or exit as well as an expansion.

references.title: GitLab retain and expand operating procedures

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Approve and finalize the chosen terms
parts.guidance: Authorized parties review and execute the final agreement or renewal action. Keep unapproved discounts, custom commitments and notice decisions out of informal correspondence.

references.title: GitLab retain and expand operating procedures

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve and finalize the chosen terms

parts.title: Reconcile the agreement with delivery and billing
parts.guidance: Verify product entitlements, invoice dates and account ownership against the final decision. Assign onboarding for new scope or orderly offboarding for a non-renewal and retain the evidence.

references.title: GitLab retain and expand operating procedures
